where.brain: Inside the skull, filling the upper part of the head.
where.eyes: In the two eye sockets of the skull, at the front of the face.
where.ears: On both sides of the head. The inner parts lie deep inside the skull.
where.nose: In the middle of the face. The nasal cavity runs back above the roof of the mouth.
where.tongue: On the floor of the mouth, joined at the back to the throat.
where.salivary: Around the mouth: in front of the ears, under the jaw and under the tongue.
where.pituitary: At the base of the brain, in a small pocket of bone behind the nose.
where.adrenals: On top of each kidney, at the back of the belly.
where.throat: Behind the nose and the mouth, running down the neck.
where.larynx: At the front of the neck, at the top of the windpipe.
where.trachea: In the neck and upper chest, in front of the food pipe, from the voice box down to the lungs.
where.lungs: In the chest, on both sides of the heart, protected by the ribcage.
where.diaphragm: Under the lungs and the heart: a dome of muscle between the chest and the belly.
where.heart: In the middle of the chest, between the two lungs and a little to the left, behind the breastbone.
where.esophagus: Behind the windpipe, from the throat through the chest and the diaphragm to the stomach.
where.stomach: In the upper left part of the belly, just under the diaphragm.
where.liver: In the upper right part of the belly, under the diaphragm and partly behind the lower ribs.
where.gallbladder: Under the liver, on the right side of the upper belly.
where.pancreas: Behind the stomach, lying across the back of the upper belly.
where.spleen: In the upper left part of the belly, behind the stomach and under the lower ribs.
where.thymus: In the upper chest, behind the breastbone and in front of the heart.
where.small_intestine: Coiled in the middle and lower belly, framed by the large intestine.
where.large_intestine: Around the edges of the belly, like a frame around the small intestine, ending at the anus.
where.kidneys: At the back of the belly, on both sides of the spine, just under the lowest ribs.
where.bladder: Low in the pelvis, behind the pubic bone.
where.testes: In the scrotum, outside the body below the penis.
where.prostate: Under the bladder, around the start of the urethra, in front of the rectum.
where.penis: At the front of the pelvis, below the pubic bone.
where.uterus: In the middle of the pelvis, between the bladder and the rectum.
where.ovaries: In the pelvis, one on each side of the uterus.
where.fallopian_tubes: In the pelvis, running from each side of the uterus towards the ovaries.
where.vagina: In the pelvis, between the bladder in front and the rectum behind.
where.breasts: On the front of the chest, over the chest muscles.
where.skull: The bones of the head. It holds the brain and shapes the face.
where.teeth: In the upper and lower jaws, inside the mouth.
where.spine: Down the middle of the back, from the skull to the pelvis.
where.ribcage: Around the chest: the ribs are joined to the spine at the back and to the breastbone in front.
where.shoulder: At the top of the chest and back: the collarbones in front and the shoulder blades behind.
where.humerus: In the upper arm, from the shoulder to the elbow.
where.forearm: Between the elbow and the wrist: the radius on the thumb side and the ulna on the little-finger side.
where.hand: In the wrist, the palm and the fingers.
where.pelvis: At the base of the spine, between the belly and the legs.
where.femur: In the thigh, from the hip to the knee.
where.knee: Between the thigh and the lower leg, with the kneecap in front.
where.lower_leg: Between the knee and the ankle: the shinbone in front and the thin fibula on the outer side.
where.foot: In the ankle, the arch of the foot and the toes.
where.bones: All through the body. Together the bones form the skeleton.
where.muscles: All through the body, joined to the bones by tendons.
where.biceps: On the front of the upper arm.
where.triceps: On the back of the upper arm.
where.deltoid: Over the top and the outer side of the shoulder.
where.chest_muscles: On the front of the chest, under the skin.
where.abs: On the front and the sides of the belly.
where.back_muscles: Along the back, from the neck down to the pelvis.
where.glutes: In the buttocks, at the back of the hips.
where.quadriceps: On the front of the thigh.
where.hamstrings: On the back of the thigh.
where.calf: On the back of the lower leg.
where.connective: All through the body, at the joints and where muscles are joined to bones.
where.spinal_cord: Inside the spine, from the base of the brain to the lower back.
where.nerves: All through the body, branching out from the brain and the spinal cord.
where.aorta: It leaves the heart in an arch, then runs down along the spine through the chest and the belly.
where.arteries: All through the body, carrying blood away from the heart.
where.veins: All through the body, carrying blood back to the heart. Many lie just under the skin.
where.lymph: All through the body, with groups of nodes in the neck, the armpits and the groin.
where.skin: Covering the whole outside of the body.
